achievements.name: House Chosen
achievements.detail: Join the Black Eagles, Blue Lions, or Golden Deer and start the school year at Garreg Mach.

achievements.name: Mock Battle
achievements.detail: Win the opening practice battle that pits your house against the other two.

achievements.name: Lesson Taught
achievements.detail: Spend weekly instruction so a student raises a skill before the next mission.

achievements.name: Exam Passed
achievements.detail: Have a unit pass a certification exam and promote into a new class.

achievements.name: Student Recruited
achievements.detail: Meet another house's conditions and bring that student into your class.

achievements.name: Dining Hall
achievements.detail: Cook a meal at the monastery and share it to lift motivation or support.

achievements.name: Tea Time
achievements.detail: Invite someone to tea and choose replies that deepen that bond.

achievements.name: Eagle and Lion
achievements.detail: Win the Battle of the Eagle and Lion, the grand clash between the three houses.

achievements.name: Support Unlocked
achievements.detail: Build support between two allies until a new conversation becomes available.

achievements.name: Paralogue Cleared
achievements.detail: Finish a character side battle and claim the reward waiting at the end.

achievements.name: Professor Level
achievements.detail: Raise your professor level so the week offers more points to spend.

achievements.name: Route Finished
achievements.detail: Carry one story path through its last chapter.
